title: 第3章 挟持宗主之女第4章 魔女苏菲儿
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 看到二长老对莫阳动手，在场的几位弟子皆是幸灾乐祸的看向莫阳。
特别是罗浩，满眼的冷厉，神色看上去异常狰狞。
他们刚才本还想着如何添油加火，只是想不到莫阳居然自己找死，敢如此强硬且直接的顶撞二长老。
他们自然也看出来了，二长老动了杀心！
只要这一掌落下去，莫阳必死无疑。
然而就在此时，莫阳身躯刷地暴退，速度快到不可思议。
在身躯退后的同时，一股波动自莫阳体内猛然透发出来。
莫阳怒了，他想不到二长老居然会直接下杀手，毫不留情！
虽然他知道二长老有着天玄境的修为，比他足足高了一个大境界，但他没有选择，若是不还手，他必死无疑。
二长老一掌落空，面露惊诧，看着退到十余米外的莫阳。
此时的莫阳周身居然透发出一股极强的真气波动。
仔细感知后，他脸色猛然一变，因为莫阳身上的波动竟然是地玄境修为的波动！
这怎么可能？
在灵虚宗，谁不知道莫阳是一个无法修炼的废物。
但此时散发出来那股气息，竟然比灵虚宗的几位天骄还强了一大截。
要知道灵虚宗公认的第一天骄弟子，似乎也只是通灵境三阶巅峰而已，距离地玄境还差一次大突破，而且年龄比莫阳大了好几岁。
后方的罗浩以及其他几人也懵了，一时间还不明白发生了什么。
“我只想安然离开！”
莫阳的声音传来，此时他周身气质大变，体表隐隐能看到一缕缕毫光在流转，那是真气透体而出所致，而这就是地玄境修为的标志。
“地玄境一阶，你竟然……”二长老一时间也在发愣，因为这太突然了。
一个公认的废物，若是步入凝气境修为还能理解，但竟然是地玄境。
他还清楚的记得，昨日后山他还感应过，莫阳半点修为都没有，怎么一夜之间……
就在此时，大长老也出现了，显然也是被这里的动静引来的。
看着莫阳，他同样满脸的匪夷所思，心中亦是吃惊万分。
不过眼前的情形他看得很清楚，心念一转，当下也顾不上其他，当先朝莫阳开口道：“你既然已经能修炼，那今后便安心留在灵虚宗，宗门不会亏待你，也不枉费了四长老这些年付出的心血！”
“呵呵，不会亏待我？这些年来宗门如何对我的？若不是师父庇护，我还有今日？”莫阳忍不住冷笑起来。
今日已经撕破脸了，他也不再顾虑什么。
在灵虚宗生活了十年，这些长老的嘴脸他很清楚，如今不过是看到了他的天赋而已，若是他展露的只是凝气境修为，只怕大长老也会对他动手。
他接着开口道：“师父惨死于大道宗强者之手，宗门敢怒不敢言，这我可以理解，但你们不该将所有矛头都指向我，我比任何人都希望师父活着！”
大长老眼眸微眯，神色渐渐冷了下来。
“你不愿留下？”
话语中已经带了几分冷意。
莫阳缓缓摇头。
“要走可以，你自废经脉，我可以让你离去！”见莫阳神色坚定，大长老话语也彻底冷了下来。
“喂不饱的白眼狼，宗门养你这么多年，若不是靠着宗门，你能走到今日？你以为这里是你想来就来，想走就走的吗？”二长老也开口，眼眸中带着缕缕杀机。
莫阳冷笑起来，随即冷喝道：“看来，今日我只能叛出宗门了！”
说话间，星皇经第一层的心法无声运转，他体内真气被疯狂的催动起来。
大长老和二长老暴怒的同时都忍不住心中吃惊，此时莫阳身上透发出来的气息强盛至极，远超寻常地玄境一阶的修者。
此时有不少弟子都被这里的动静惹来了，都纷纷凑了上来。
莫阳心中一直在想如何才能活着离去，虽然他身上一夜之间发生了天翻地覆的变化，但他也深知大长老和二长老的可怕，若是硬碰硬，他根本支撑不了几个回合。
他不动声色的朝那些围拢上来的宗门弟子看了一眼，随后目光落在了一个刚出现的少女身上，那是宗主之女苏菲儿！
莫阳全力运转体内力量，施展灵虚宗的身法灵虚步，身躯佯装攻击，实则快速朝一旁闪掠出去。
二长老和大长老都以为莫阳要和他们硬碰硬，都下意识的催动真气防御，只是没想到莫阳的目标根本就不是他们，身躯从一旁极速闪过，直接冲向了那些弟子。
“畜生，你找死！”二长老回神后大怒。
content_en:
Seeing the second elder taking action against Mo Yang, several disciples present looked at Mo Yang with gloating.
Especially Luo Hao, his eyes were full of coldness and his expression looked extremely ferocious.
They were just thinking about how to add fuel to the fire, but they didn't expect that Mo Yang would actually seek death himself and dare to contradict the second elder so forcefully and directly.
Naturally, they also saw that the second elder had murderous intentions!
As long as this palm falls, Mo Yang will definitely die.
However, at this moment, Mo Yang's body suddenly retreated from the ground at an incredible speed.
At the same time as his body retreated, a wave of waves suddenly emitted from Mo Yang's body.
Mo Yang was angry. He didn't expect that the second elder would kill directly without mercy!
Although he knew that the second elder had a cultivation level in the Tianxuan realm, which was a level higher than him, he had no choice. If he didn't fight back, he would definitely die.
The second elder's palm missed, and he looked at Mo Yang who retreated more than ten meters away with a surprised look on his face.
At this time, Mo Yang's whole body actually emitted a very strong wave of true energy.
After carefully sensing it, his expression suddenly changed, because the fluctuations on Mo Yang's body turned out to be fluctuations in the cultivation of the Earth Profound Realm!
How is this possible?
In Lingxu Sect, who doesn't know that Mo Yang is a waste who cannot cultivate.
But the aura that came out at this moment was actually a lot stronger than the geniuses of Lingxu Sect.
You must know that the recognized number one disciple of Lingxu Sect seems to be only at the peak of the third level of the Psychic Realm. He is still one short of a major breakthrough to the Earthly Profound Realm, and he is several years older than Mo Yang.
Luo Hao and several others behind were also stunned, and they didn't understand what happened for a while.
"I just want to leave in peace!"
Mo Yang's voice came, and at this moment his whole body's temperament changed drastically, and wisps of light could be faintly seen flowing on the surface of his body. This was caused by the true energy leaking out of the body, and this was the sign of cultivation in the Earthly Profound Realm.
"First level of the Earth Profound Realm, you actually..." The second elder was also in a daze for a moment because this was too sudden.
A recognized waste, if he had entered the Qi Condensation Realm, he would still be understandable, but he turned out to be in the Earth Xuan Realm.
He still clearly remembered that he had sensed it in the back mountain yesterday. Mo Yang didn't have any cultivation at all. How could he... overnight?
At this moment, the Great Elder also appeared, apparently attracted by the movement here.
Looking at Mo Yang, he also had a look of disbelief on his face, and he was also extremely surprised in his heart.
However, he saw the situation in front of him clearly, and with a change of heart, he couldn't care about anything else at the moment, and said to Mo Yang first: "Since you are able to practice, you can stay in Lingxu Sect with peace of mind from now on. The sect will not treat you badly, and the efforts of the fourth elders over the years will not be in vain!"
"Haha, you won't treat me badly? How has the sect treated me all these years? If it weren't for Master's protection, would I still be here today?" Mo Yang couldn't help but sneer.
Today he has broken up with each other, and he no longer worries about anything.
After living in Lingxu Sect for ten years, he knew the faces of these elders very well. Now he just saw his talent. If he only showed his Qi Condensation Realm cultivation, he was afraid that the great elder would also take action against him.
He then said: "Master died tragically at the hands of a strong man from the Dao Sect. The sect dares to be angry but dare not speak out. I can understand this, but you should not point all your fingers at me. I want Master to live more than anyone else!"
The great elder's eyes narrowed slightly, and his expression gradually became colder.
"You don't want to stay?"
There was already a bit of coldness in his words.
Mo Yang slowly shook his head.
"You can leave if you want. If you destroy your meridians, I can let you leave!" Seeing Mo Yang's firm expression, the great elder's words became completely cold.
"You insatiable white-eyed wolf, the sect has raised you for so many years. If it weren't for the sect, would you be able to get where you are today? Do you think you can come here and leave whenever you want?" The second elder also spoke, with murderous intent in his eyes.
Mo Yang sneered, and then shouted coldly: "It seems that I can only betray the sect today!"
As he spoke, the mental techniques of the first level of the Star Emperor Sutra were silently operating, and the true energy in his body was being activated crazily.
While the First Elder and the Second Elder were furious, they couldn't help but be surprised. At this time, the aura coming from Mo Yang was extremely powerful, far exceeding that of ordinary cultivators of the first level of the Earthly Mysterious Realm.
At this time, many disciples were attracted by the commotion here, and they all came together one after another.
Mo Yang has been thinking about how to leave alive. Although he has undergone earth-shaking changes overnight, he also knows how terrifying the First Elder and Second Elder are. If they were to confront each other head-on, he would not be able to last for more than a few rounds.
He calmly glanced at the sect disciples who had gathered around him, and then his eyes fell on a girl who had just appeared. That was Sophie, the daughter of the sect leader!
"Brush..."
Mo Yang used all the power in his body and used the Lingxu Sect's movement technique, Lingxu Step. His body pretended to attack, but in fact he quickly dodged to the side.
The second elder and the first elder both thought that Mo Yang was going to confront them head-on, so they subconsciously activated their zhenqi defense. However, they did not expect that Mo Yang's target was not them at all. His body flashed past the side and rushed directly towards the disciples.
"Beast, you are looking for death!" The second elder was furious after regaining consciousness.
title_en: Chapter 3: Kidnapping the Sect Master’s Daughter Chapter 4: Witch Sophie
